name: DentSheet
title: From dent count to repair estimate.
build: A phone-based inspection tool connects panel photos and dent counts to the estimate, repair record, and invoice.
benefit: The estimator and body shop work from the same figures. A rate change keeps the original estimate intact.

name: MetalShopHQ
title: Follow a fabrication job from quote to shipment.
build: A shared job board keeps drawings, time entries, purchasing, and costs with each fabrication job.
benefit: The office can see what’s on the floor, and operators can open the drawing and work plan for the job in front of them.

name: La Clinique du Voyageur
title: Help travellers find care in two languages.
build: We rebuilt the Montréal clinic’s French and English website and trained staff to use AI for content updates and small internal tools.
benefit: Travellers can find services and booking information in their language. Staff have the skills to keep those details current.

name: MetalQuoteHQ
title: Turn a messy request into a priced quote.
build: Estimators can import an email, photo, or PDF, review its metal line items, compare supplier prices, and issue a customer quote.
benefit: Each price sits beside the material it covers. The estimator can choose a supplier and apply markup without rebuilding the quote in a spreadsheet.

name: FrothMonkey
title: Match what someone wants with what’s nearby.
build: We built a marketplace where people post what they want or have. AI suggests relevant matches between the two.
benefit: A buyer can describe an item once and review potential matches as nearby sellers list what they have.

name: FastFunLearning
title: Turn counting and spelling practice into play.
build: A collection of short browser games lets children pop numbers in order, collect letters, and solve animal Sudoku puzzles.
benefit: Children get a response to each move and can practise a skill again at their own pace.

name: Kelray Heating
title: Help buyers size a heater for their space.
build: We rebuilt the outdoor heating storefront and added a planner that uses the customer’s space and measurements to guide heater selection.
benefit: Customers can explore a layout and a suggested heater before asking the Kelray team for advice.

name: Leon Lebeniste Portal
title: Give each distributor the right catalogue and pricing.
build: A private portal lets approved distributors browse products, see their volume pricing, build an order, and generate a branded quote.
benefit: Orders follow Leon Lebeniste’s pricing and approval rules from the start. The team had a working prototype to test in two business days.

name: Outflow Plumbing
title: Turn a plumbing referral into a useful enquiry.
build: Homeowners can explore eight plumbing and heating services, see photos of Kyle’s installations, and describe their job through the enquiry form.
benefit: Homeowners can show Kyle the type of job they need, and he receives the details in the inbox he already uses.
